dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage with multi-immune in vivo CAR therapy approach. First patient dosed in April 2026 for lead program MT-304.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: First patient dosing achieved for MT-304 in Phase 1/2 study as of April 2026. No specific efficacy or safety data disclosed in available sources.
dossier.indications_pursued: HER2-positive solid tumors for lead program MT-304. No additional indications specified in available data.
dossier.delivery_approach: Multi-immune in vivo platform encompassing CAR-T, CAR-NK, and all-RNA RetroT technologies. Specific delivery mechanism not detailed in available sources.
dossier.key_differentiators: Multi-immune approach combining CAR-T, CAR-NK, and all-RNA RetroT platforms in single in vivo system. First-in-class designation claimed for MT-304 program.
dossier.last_significant_event: First patient dosed in Phase 1/2 study of MT-304 on April 23, 2026. Company presented platform data at AACR 2026 conference in April 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage company with TSRA-196 entering trials for Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency. Uses in vivo gene therapy approach targeting patients with the PiZZ genotype.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 1/2 trial (NCT07227207) for TSRA-196 in AATD patients with PiZZ genotype is registered but not yet recruiting. No clinical or preclinical efficacy data has been disclosed.
dossier.indications_pursued: Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency (AATD) affecting lung and/or liver in patients with PiZZ genotype. Focus on genetic deficiency disorder with clear patient population.
dossier.last_significant_event: Registration of Phase 1/2 clinical trial NCT07227207 for TSRA-196 in Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency. Trial includes dose escalation, expansion, and single repeat dose components.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with UB-VV111, an in vivo approach for B-cell malignancies currently in dose-escalation and dose-confirmation studies.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 1 trial (NCT06528301) is actively recruiting patients with relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma and chronic lymphocytic leukemia. No efficacy or safety data has been disclosed yet.
dossier.indications_pursued: B-cell hematologic malignancies including large B-cell lymphoma, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, and chronic lymphocytic leukemia. Focus is on relapsed/refractory patient populations.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 clinical trial NCT06528301 for UB-VV111 in B-cell lymphomas, currently recruiting patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company with CPTX2309 asset currently recruiting in healthy volunteers and rheumatoid arthritis patients.
dossier.indications_pursued: Rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus, focusing on moderate to severe disease presentations.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiated Phase 1 clinical trial NCT06917742 for CPTX2309 in healthy volunteers and rheumatoid arthritis patients, currently recruiting.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies. Lead asset KLN-1010 is currently in a recruiting Phase 1 trial for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 1 trial (NCT07075185) evaluating safety, tolerability, and recommended Phase 2 dose of KLN-1010 in multiple myeloma patients. No efficacy or safety data has been publicly disclosed.
dossier.indications_pursued: Multiple myeloma in relapse and refractory settings. Focus appears to be on hematologic malignancies based on the single disclosed program.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T delivery platform. Specific delivery mechanism or vector technology not disclosed in available data.
dossier.last_significant_event: Eli Lilly acquisition announced in April 2026 for up to $7 billion, described as the largest in vivo CAR-T deal to date.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Early Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies delivered via direct injection. Currently has 4 clinical trials, with the most advanced being an early Phase 1 study.
dossier.indications_pursued: Targeting hematological malignancies including relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma, B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia, and B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Also pursuing refractory autoimmune diseases with CD19/BCMA dual targeting.
dossier.delivery_approach: Direct injection delivery platform for in vivo CAR-T generation using assets JY231 (targeting B-cell malignancies) and JY232 (for multiple myeloma).
dossier.key_differentiators: Dual CD19/BCMA targeting approach for autoimmune indications represents a distinctive application of in vivo CAR-T beyond oncology. Multiple investigator-initiated trials suggest academic collaboration strategy.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of recruiting status for multiple clinical trials including NCT07336823 (JY232 in multiple myeloma) and NCT06890065 (JY231 in B-cell malignancies).

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with assets HN2301 and HN2302 for autoimmune diseases. Multiple trials ongoing or planned across different autoimmune indications.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases including systemic lupus erythematosus, systemic sclerosis, and refractory myasthenia gravis. Focus appears to be on multiple autoimmune indications with similar therapeutic approach.
dossier.last_significant_event: Phase 1 trial for HN2302 in autoimmune diseases including SLE registered in 2024 (NCT07523282, not yet recruiting).

dossier.stage_and_modality: Currently in Phase 1/2 clinical development with EN-374 for X-linked chronic granulomatous disease.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 1/2 trial (NCT06876363) actively recruiting patients to evaluate safety and potential efficacy of EN-374 treatment regimen for X-linked chronic granulomatous disease.
dossier.indications_pursued: Primary focus on chronic granulomatous disease, including X-linked CGD specifically. Previously pursued sickle cell disease and hematological malignancies with MGTA-145 asset.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1/2 clinical trial (NCT06876363) for EN-374 in X-linked chronic granulomatous disease, currently recruiting patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with in vivo CAR-T therapy platform across oncology and autoimmune indications.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Three active Phase 1 trials evaluating safety, tolerability, and preliminary efficacy across hematologic malignancies and autoimmune diseases, though specific data outcomes are not yet reported.
dossier.indications_pursued: Hematologic cancers including non-Hodgkin's lymphoma, large B-cell lymphoma, and chronic lymphocytic leukemia, plus autoimmune diseases including systemic lupus erythematosus.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T platform with assets SC262 and SC291, though specific delivery mechanisms are not detailed in available data.
dossier.key_differentiators: Hypoimmune cell therapy approach combined with in vivo CAR-T technology platform, with expansion into autoimmune applications beyond traditional oncology focus.
dossier.last_significant_event: Achievement of new milestone in cell therapy for Type 1 diabetes in April 2026, indicating pipeline expansion beyond disclosed Phase 1 programs.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 development with intramuscular delivery approach for EVM14 in solid tumors.
dossier.indications_pursued: Selected solid tumors (EVM14), primary membranous nephropathy (EVER001), and primary immunoglobulin A nephropathy (Nefecon).
dossier.delivery_approach: Intramuscular administration for EVM14 asset targeting solid tumors.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1/2 trial NCT07095868 evaluating EVM14 alone and in combination with pembrolizumab in solid tumors.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapy using circular RNA delivered via lipid nanoparticles targeting T cells.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Two Phase 1 trials currently recruiting, including first-in-human studies for both healthy volunteers (ORN252) and autoimmune disease patients.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases including systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and Sjogren's syndrome, targeting CD19-positive cells.
dossier.delivery_approach: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) that specifically target T cells and deliver circular RNA encoding CD19 chimeric antigen receptor.
dossier.key_differentiators: Uses circular RNA instead of conventional mRNA or viral vectors for CAR expression, combined with T cell-targeting LNP delivery system.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of two Phase 1 clinical trials, both currently recruiting patients as of latest data.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage company developing CAR-T cell therapies, with OriCAR-017 currently in recruiting trials for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Two Phase 1/2 trials (NCT06271252 and NCT06182696) evaluating OriCAR-017 anti-GPRC5D CAR-T in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma patients are currently recruiting. No efficacy or safety data has been disclosed yet.
dossier.indications_pursued: Multiple myeloma (relapsed/refractory) with OriCAR-017 targeting GPRC5D. Solid tumor CAR-T programs are mentioned in funding news but specific indications not disclosed.
dossier.key_differentiators: Anti-GPRC5D targeting approach for multiple myeloma and expansion into solid tumor CAR-T therapies.
dossier.last_significant_event: Raised $110 million in pre-IPO financing in April 2026 to advance solid tumor CAR-T pipeline and prepare for IPO.

dossier.stage_and_modality: CARsgen is conducting Phase 1/2 clinical trials with ex vivo CAR-T cell therapies across multiple solid tumor indications.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: The company has Phase 1b/2 trials of CT041 (anti-claudin18.2 CAR-T) in advanced gastric adenocarcinoma and pancreatic cancer that are active but not recruiting, suggesting data readout may be forthcoming.
dossier.indications_pursued: CARsgen targets solid tumors including gastric adenocarcinoma, pancreatic cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma, and hematologic malignancies including relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.
dossier.delivery_approach: The company uses ex vivo CAR-T cell therapy with autologous T cells engineered to target specific antigens including claudin18.2.
dossier.key_differentiators: CARsgen focuses on solid tumor CAR-T applications with claudin18.2 targeting for digestive system cancers. The company has a commercial product called Zevorcabtagene Autoleucel (zevor-cel) for multiple myeloma with planned 15-year long-term follow-up studies.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of a Phase 1b trial (NCT06560827) evaluating CT011 CAR-T cells in hepatocellular carcinoma patients at risk of recurrence after surgical resection, which is currently recruiting.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Early clinical stage company with multiple Phase 1 trials for in vivo CAR-T candidates IMV101 and IMV102, plus one Phase 3 trial for IMC002.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Preclinical data for IMV102 demonstrated durable tumor control, as presented at AACR 2026.
dossier.indications_pursued: Targeting hematologic malignancies including relapsed/refractory B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma and multiple myeloma, plus solid tumors with CLDN18.2-positive gastric adenocarcinoma.
dossier.last_significant_event: Presented preclinical data for IMV102 showing durable tumor control at AACR 2026 conference in April 2026.
